title: Bid details for a vendor that has not bid is 'bid not found', not a crash
preconditions: Session: the BUYER (the run's buyer, owner of the sandbox). The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids. {{vendorUuid}} is the client's QA vendor company, {{userUuid}} an active user.
steps: 1. GET /bids/get_bid_details for the QA vendor company and a user on the sandbox round, which has no bids.
expectedResult: HTTP 422 — code 32 'Bid not found' (or 101 if the caller is not the round's owner). Never 500: today bid is nil and `bid.errors` (bids_controller.rb:385) / `bid.id` (:378) raise.
rationale: Opening a vendor's row before it bids is an ordinary action.

title: Bid details on a round that does not exist is 'request not found'
preconditions: Session: the BUYER (the run's buyer, owner of the sandbox). The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids. {{vendorUuid}} is the client's QA vendor company, {{userUuid}} an active user.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 4 'Request not found' — no active/closed stage with that id (app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb:365-366).
rationale: Typed refusal for an unknown round.

title: Suspicious-bid details on a round without the indicator are refused, never a crash
preconditions: Session: the BUYER (the run's buyer, owner of the sandbox). The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids. {{vendorUuid}} is the client's QA vendor company, {{userUuid}} an active user.
steps: 1. GET /bids/get_suspicious_bids_detail for the sandbox round (indicator not switched on by this run).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' when the stage config is_suspicious_bid_indicator_enabled is not true (app/models/model_helpers/trade_request_model_helper.rb:81-88; bids_controller.rb:393); HTTP 200 [] if the client's template turns it on. Never 5xx.
rationale: The list maps IPs to vendor names; it exists only where enabled.
